text:
maria: Heads-up: eu-west GPU pool has been >95% used for the last 8m. I'm proposing we flip the admit policy from hard rejects to a short soft-queue + graded degrade for bursty requests. Thoughts?

raj: +1. Rejects cause frantic client retries and make spikes worse. A short queue with a graceful degrade path should reduce thundering.

lucas: Need to be explicit what 'degrade' means here. Returning partial outputs vs serving a lower-fidelity model? We must track customer-visible failures.

maria: Plan sketch:
- soft-queue with max wait = 6s
- if still waiting, fallback to degrade levels:
  1) reuse prefix/KV cache hint (no re-attend)
  2) route to quantized variant (int8)
  3) apply max_tokens=64 and response-summarization hint
- only after degrade levels exhausted do we return a 429
This is scoped to shared hosted text-gen in eu-west. Dedicated pools unaffected.

tanya: Product ok with that sequence? We need to confirm embeddings and rerankers aren't hit.

maria: Embeddings and reranking are pinned to dedicated pools, so unaffected. This is only for standard completion/chat endpoints on shared capacity.

raj: Config snippet for the admit controller (proto-style):
```json
{
  "admit_policy": "soft_queue",
  "queue_max_ms": 6000,
  "degrade_steps": ["kv_hint","quantized_model","short_response"],
  "final_action": "reject"
}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout: admit-policy v2 -> eu-west canary=5% (initiated by maria) :rocket:

sre-oncall: Quick ops requests: add temporary alert and dashboard tiles:
- eu-west.soft_queue.length > 50 -> page oncall
- eu-west.degrade.rate > 0.5% -> slack #eng-infra-notify
- p99 latency and client-retry-rate for canary traffic

lucas: Also ensure telemetry tags for degrade path: `admit_path=soft_queue`, `degrade_level=1/2/3`, `quantized=true/false`. That lets us slice by customers and measure visible regressions.

maria: Canary rollout criteria (proposed): 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~3h if all pass. Abort if any of:
- p99 latency increases > 100ms over baseline
- error rate > 1.5%
- customer-visible degrade > 0.7% (measured by tracebacks + user-reported tickets)

tanya: I'll draft a short support template and a customer-facing FAQ blurb so support has copy.

raj: Cost note: quantized variant yields ~2x throughput and ~18% unit-cost improvement for heavy sequences, but small quality delta. Good tradeoff for burst mitigation.

maria: Action items:
- raj: add alerts + implement admit controller config
- lucas: add telemetry tags + chart on canary dashboard
- tanya: draft support notice and internal FAQ
- maria: open PR with config + runbook link and kick off canary

maria: PR (WIP): https://git.redwood/infra/admit_policy/pull/789

sre-oncall: Oncall acked, I'll watch the alerts and health dashboard during canary.

maria: Thanks all — I'll check back after 30m and post canary metrics. :thumbsup:
